items.difficulty_reason: The retained proof is a complete computation: identifies RGamma(U,F)^wedge with RGamma(U, Rlim F/I^nF) via the two named in-chapter lemmas (formal-functions-general, derived-completion-pseudo-coherent), extracts the Milnor short exact sequences via the Cohomology lemma on RGamma commuting with Rlim, and kills the R^1 lim terms via the Mittag-Leffler condition from Lemma ML-local. Every step is written out. Retained author proof at lines 3748-3766.
